import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Mint {
        private int value;
        static int MOD;

        public Mint(long x) {
            value = normalize(x);
        }

        public static int normalize(long x) {
            int v = (int)(x % MOD);
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return v;
        }

        public int getValue() { return value; }

        public Mint add(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)value + other.value);
        }

        public Mint subtract(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)value - other.value);
        }

        public Mint multiply(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((long)value * other.value);
        }

        public Mint divide(Mint other) {
            return this.multiply(new Mint(modInv(other.value)));
        }

        public Mint negate() {
            return new Mint(-value);
        }

        public Mint add(int x) {
            return new Mint((long)value + x);
        }

        public Mint multiply(int x) {
            return new Mint((long)value * x);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(value);
        }

        // Extended Euclidean algorithm
        public static long egcd(long a, long b, long[] xy) {
            if (b == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1;
                xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            long[] xy1 = new long[2];
            long g = egcd(b, a % b, xy1);
            xy[0] = xy1[1];
            xy[1] = xy1[0] - (a / b) * xy1[1];
            return g;
        }

        // Modular inverse
        public static int modInv(int a) {
            long[] xy = new long[2];
            long g = egcd(a, MOD, xy);
            assert g == 1 : "Modular inverse does not exist";
            long x = xy[0];
            if (x < 0) x += MOD;
            return (int)x;
        }

        // Power (not used in main, but kept for completeness)
        public static Mint power(Mint a, long b) {
            assert b >= 0;
            Mint x = a;
            Mint res = new Mint(1);
            long p = b;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(x);
                x = x.multiply(x);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int md = sc.nextInt();
        Mint.MOD = md;

        // Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to m
        Mint[] fact = new Mint[m + 1];
        Mint[] inv_fact = new Mint[m + 1];
        fact[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1].multiply(i);
        }
        inv_fact[m] = new Mint(1).divide(fact[m]);
        for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1].multiply(i + 1);
        }

        // Combination function
        java.util.function.BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Mint> C = (x, y) -> {
            if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Mint(0);
            return fact[x].multiply(inv_fact[y]).multiply(inv_fact[x - y]);
        };

        // ptr_dp and ptr_ways
        Mint[] ptr_ways = new Mint[m + 1];
        Mint[] ptr_dp = new Mint[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptr_ways[i] = new Mint(0);
            ptr_dp[i] = new Mint(0);
        }
        ptr_ways[0] = new Mint(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            // First loop for ptr_ways
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint term = ptr_ways[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r])
                    .multiply(C.apply(l + r, l))
                    .multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2));
                ptr_ways[i] = ptr_ways[i].add(term);
            }
            // Second loop for ptr_dp
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint add = (new Mint(l).multiply(l + 1).add(new Mint(r).multiply(r + 1)))
                    .divide(new Mint(2));
                Mint term1 = ptr_ways[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r])
                    .multiply(C.apply(l + r, l))
                    .multiply(add);
                Mint term2 = (ptr_dp[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r]).add(ptr_dp[r].multiply(ptr_ways[l])))
                    .multiply(C.apply(l + r, r))
                    .multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2));
                ptr_dp[i] = ptr_dp[i].add(term1).add(term2);
            }
        }

        // dp and ways 2D arrays
        Mint[][] dp = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        Mint[][] ways = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= m; s++) {
                dp[i][s] = new Mint(0);
                ways[i][s] = new Mint(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Mint(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptr_dp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptr_ways[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Mint ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Mint way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(
                        way.multiply(ptr_ways[add]).multiply(C.apply(s, add))
                    );
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(
                        (way.multiply(ptr_dp[add]).add(ptr_ways[add].multiply(ft)))
                        .multiply(C.apply(s, add))
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
